sentences.text: The only known specimen is a nearly complete frontoparietal dome belonging to a subadult individual.
This fused skull dome measured 53.2 mm in length and 19 mm in maximum thickness.
The parietal bones contributed an exceptionally large 41% of the total dome length.
Based on its age, Amtocephale is considered the oldest known pachycephalosaurid dinosaur.
The genus was named in 2011 by Mahito Watabe, Khishigjaw Tsogtbaatar, and Robert M. Sullivan.
The fossil site at Amtgai was excavated in 1993, 1994, 2001, and 2004.
The species is classified within the family Pachycephalosauridae.
This dinosaur lived during the early Late Cretaceous in the southern Gobi Desert of Mongolia.
Recent dating suggests the formation containing the fossils is between 95.9 and 89.6 million years old.
It lived approximately 85 million years ago during the Cenomanian and Santonian stages of the Late Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
It is debated whether Amtocephale is the oldest pachycephalosaurid, as this depends on the exact age of the geological formation.
